messages.content: For user_01, please check if the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones are in stock in the audio category. I want 1 unit of product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and my items are [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}]. Also look up the bedroom light in the bedroom area using device_id light_bedroom and the device type query light, and check any coupons on my account, including coupon_code SAVE15, to find the best discount for buying 1 pair. Then place the order on my credit_card, send me an in-app purchase confirmation document, and also create a paypal invoice for the same headphones and email it to alice@company.com for alice. After that, check the status of the bedroom light, restart it, get the current time in America/New_York, and send alice a high-priority app alert that the device is restarting and to wait 30 seconds before reconnecting.
